Metadata.title: Jetforge Labs | Small apps for less friction in your day
Metadata.description: Small apps for less friction: Dilo for when you'd rather talk than type, Macbrow for your notch, Checkmate for the things you need to remember.
Metadata.keywords: Mac apps, macOS apps, Dilo, Macbrow, Checkmate, LimitBar, dictation for Mac, notch app for Mac, MacBook notch, task manager for Mac, iPhone apps, task manager for iPhone, to do list app, menu bar app, custom software, software studio, Jetforge Labs
Metadata.ogAlt: Jetforge Labs. Small apps for less friction in your day: Dilo, Macbrow and Checkmate.

Hero.sub: Small apps for the things that eat your time: typing what you could say, hunting for what you just had, remembering everything else.

dilo.name: Dilo
dilo.line: Dilo writes what you say in any app, and turns calls into notes. On your Mac.
dilo.proNote: Try everything free for {days} days. After that dictation, your history and voice notes stay free. Pro is €49, one payment.

macbrow.name: Macbrow
macbrow.line: Turns the notch into a shelf for your files, a cleaner for your screenshots, a meeting alert, a music player and a calendar.
macbrow.proNote: Try everything free for {days} days. After that Shelf, music, battery and clock stay free. Pro is €7.99, one payment.

checkmate.name: Checkmate
checkmate.line: Put it in Checkmate and clear your list. On your Mac and iPhone, synced through your iCloud. No account, no sign-up.

limitbar.name: LimitBar
limitbar.line: Shows your Claude Code and Codex limits in the menu bar.

berth.name: Berth
berth.line: A Dock for your Mac that stays out of the way, with live window previews and a shelf.

deepspy.name: DeepSpy
deepspy.line: Find what's eating your disk and clean it up: a space map, junk finder and app uninstaller.

tide.name: Tide
tide.line: A modern terminal for your Mac, built native.

dilo.lede: Dilo writes what you say in any app. And it turns calls, talks and voice notes into notes you can search and ask. On your Mac, offline.
dilo.shotLabel: Dilo dictating into an email: it heard ‘um, let’s meet Tuesday, no, Wednesday at ten and, well, bring the revised budget’, crossed out the fillers and the correction, and pasted the clean sentence.
dilo.fine: No card, no account. Then Basic stays free. No subscription, up to 3 Macs.
dilo.afterNote: After the trial, AI cleanup, meetings and Ask need Pro. Dictation, history, notes and export keep working.

basic.title: Basic
basic.note: After the trial. Nothing you recorded is deleted.

dictate.title: Dictate into any app
dictate.text: Double tap, talk, tap again. 19 languages, right at your cursor.

dictionary.title: Your names, spelled right
dictionary.text: Pin names, brands and terms with their capitals and accents.

repaste.title: History and paste again
repaste.text: Every dictation is kept. <kbd>esc</kbd> cancels without pasting.

notes.title: Voice notes
notes.text: Stop recording and the text is already there.

export.title: Take it with you
export.text: Save any note as Markdown or plain text.

search.title: Read and search everything
search.text: Meetings, notes and summaries from your trial stay yours.

cleanup.title: Fillers out, your voice intact
cleanup.text: AI removes the ums and “Tuesday, no”. Your style isn’t rewritten.

meetings.title: Meetings without bots
meetings.text: Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime or any audio your Mac plays. Transcript, summary, decisions, tasks, and who said what.

ask.title: Ask your Vault
ask.text: Ask about anything you recorded. Answers cite the meeting, the date and the minute.

local.title: A model that lives on your Mac
local.text: No account, no API keys, no per-use fees.

commands.title: Ten commands of your own
commands.text: Turn a note into an email or a summary, one key each.

macbrow.phrase: I just need it for a minute.
macbrow.meta: macOS 15+ · made for MacBooks with a notch
macbrow.lede: Macbrow turns the notch into a shelf for files, a cleaner for your screenshots, a meeting alert, a music player and a calendar. Drag something onto the notch and it opens to catch it.
macbrow.fine: No card, no account. No subscription, up to 3 Macs.
macbrow.panelAlt: Macbrow open under the notch: a song playing with progress, playback and volume controls, and the November calendar with the Weekly sync happening now and a Stand-up next.

screenshots.title: A Desktop that stays clean
screenshots.text: New screenshots land on the Shelf with a countdown and go to the Trash on their own if you never use them. Drag, copy, share or pin one to keep it.
screenshots.meta: Keep for 24 h, 3 days or 7 days · “Put Back” restores an expired one
screenshots.alt: Macbrow’s Shelf tab holding 8 items. Visible: three screenshots, two with an expiry badge (20 h and 3 h), a banner image, an invoice PDF, a folder named Brand assets and a text snippet cut off at the edge.

meetings.title: A heads-up before every meeting
meetings.text: Shortly before an event, the closed notch expands with the time left in your calendar’s colour. Click for the details and join in one click.
meetings.meta: Join on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex · 1 to 15 minutes ahead
meetings.alt: The closed notch stretched into a meeting reminder: a dot in the calendar’s colour on the left and ‘in 1 min’ on the right.
meetings.caption: Closed notch, one minute before

shelf.title: Park files, links, text and images
shelf.text: They survive restarts. Drag them out, share or AirDrop them.

header.title: Clock and battery
header.text: A large clock when nothing is playing.

mirror.title: Check your camera
mirror.text: A quick look before a call.

drawer.title: Pull down six integrations
drawer.text: Reminders, Shortcuts, Weather, Checkmate, Dilo, LimitBar.

assistant.title: Ask about your day
assistant.text: On-device with Apple Intelligence, macOS 26+. Nothing happens until you confirm.

clipboard.label: Clipboard
clipboard.alt: Macbrow’s Clipboard tab: four recent copies as cards (a code snippet, one file, a link to example.com and meeting notes), each with how long ago it was copied, plus pause and trash buttons.

focus.label: Focus
focus.alt: Macbrow’s Focus tab: a ring with a 15:37 timer, a Timer and Pomodoro switch, and Pause and Reset buttons.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.alt: Macbrow’s Assistant answering ‘What does my day look like?’ after checking the calendar: the Weekly sync under way, Stand-up at 12:30 and lunch at 14:00.

weather.label: Drawer: Weather
weather.alt: Macbrow’s Home with the drawer open on Weather: 4 degrees and partly cloudy in Oslo, the next twelve hours and the next five days, data from MET Norway.

checkmate.label: Drawer: Checkmate
checkmate.alt: Macbrow’s Home with the drawer open on Checkmate: one overdue task, three for today and two for Monday, each with its project and time.

also.text: Also in the notch: today’s calendar with a week strip, a pixel pet that reacts to your day, Light, Glass and Black styles, every connected display and six languages. On displays without a notch it shows as a small pill in the menu bar.
also.petAlt: The closed notch with a small blue pixel cat walking on its left side.
also.petCaption: The pet, in the closed notch

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for Jetforge Labs and all its applications and services.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.p1: Jetforge Labs OÜ ("we", "us", or "our") operates websites, mobile applications, and other digital products and services (collectively, "Services"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use any of our Services.
intro.p2: By accessing or using our Services, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this policy, please do not access our Services.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.p1: We may collect the following types of information:
collect.item1: Personal information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and any messages you send through our contact forms.
collect.item2: Usage data collected automatically, including device information, browser type, operating system, IP address, and interaction patterns within our Services.
collect.item3: Analytics data through third-party services to understand how our Services are used and to improve user experience.
collect.item4: Advertising identifiers and related data when our applications display ads, used to serve relevant advertisements.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.p1: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
use.item1: To provide, maintain, and improve our Services.
use.item2: To communicate with you, including responding to inquiries and sending service-related notices.
use.item3: To analyze usage trends and optimize the performance and user experience of our Services.
use.item4: To display advertisements within our applications, including personalized ads where applicable.
use.item5: To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: Our Services may integrate with third-party services that collect information independently. These may include:
thirdParty.item1: Analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics) to track usage and performance.
thirdParty.item2: Advertising networks (e.g., Google AdMob) to display ads within our applications.
thirdParty.item3: Cloud hosting and infrastructure providers to store and process data securely.
thirdParty.p2: These third-party services have their own privacy policies, and we encourage you to review them. We are not responsible for the practices of these third parties.

security.heading: Data Storage & Security
security.p1: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
security.p2: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.p1: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
rights.item1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
rights.item2: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
rights.item3: Request deletion of your personal data.
rights.item4: Object to or restrict the processing of your personal data.
rights.p2: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.p1: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the applicable age of consent in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child without parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically to stay informed about how we are protecting your information.
